scene.description: At most 12 words on what the camera shows

video_visible.description: false if no video was received or the frames cannot be made out

events.description: Real events first (highest priority first), then look-alikes; at most 5; empty if none

start_s.description: Seconds from clip start when the event begins

end_s.description: Seconds from clip start when it ends, or the clip length if ongoing
